handoff.salientSummary: Implemented orphaned Kubernetes Job detection and cleanup for the cancellation handler feature. Added OrphanCleaner service that scans for Jobs without corresponding evaluations or with terminal state evaluations, cleans them up along with associated ConfigMaps and Secrets. All tests pass (10 new tests for orphan cleanup logic).
handoff.whatWasImplemented: Implemented orphaned Kubernetes Job detection and cleanup service (OrphanCleaner) for the cancellation handler feature. The OrphanCleaner scans for orphaned Jobs whose evaluation records are deleted from the database or are in terminal states (completed/failed/cancelled) with active Jobs still running. It cleans up the orphaned Jobs along with associated ConfigMaps and Secrets. Includes configurable scan interval, MaxCleanupAge to avoid race conditions, and comprehensive test coverage. The cancellation flow (DELETE /api/v1/evaluations/:id) already existed in the handler and orchestrator, which deletes the K8s Job, updates DB status to cancelled, and preserves partial results.
